platform.rule: Prepare-fixed inventory; every platform library open must match it through exit, followed by stat/digest verification.

MAT/instrument.rule: Exact existing MAT library pins; unknown instrument-library opens refuse through exit, and known pins are digest-checked after exit. Directory/rootmap access remains allowed.

environment/conda/ROOT.rule: Existing reviewed-prefix and exclusion rules are applied to every completed open, including late loads. No snapshot-only admission and no new per-library pin rule.

system.rule: Existing system-prefix and exclusion rules are applied to every completed open through exit; protected roots override all classes.
